Help

Goal. Survive the school year (Aug 28 → Jun 23). If POP reaches 0 the run ends immediately. Otherwise you get an ending based on your stats, relationships and remembered choices.

Each day. A school event with choices. Then 3 after-school time blocks to talk with people, study, work, or shop. Press End day when done; random events, personal events and birthdays can happen in the evening. Classmates and family may also surprise you: compliments, small gifts, invitations, or word that someone has been talking about you.

Phone. The 📱 button opens your phone. Texting is free (no time block) but limited to 4 texts a day: chat, compliment, ask for help or advice, cheer someone up, apologise, borrow or lend a little money. Friends also text you first, sometimes with quick replies. Hanging out, studying, gifts and rumours still happen in person.

Stats. POP (0–100), Money, Grade, and a relationship (−100…+100) with each of the 40 characters. Helping or hurting someone also moves their friends a little.

Risks. Study checks depend on your Grade and prep. Cheating can get you caught. Rumors can reach their target, get disproven, and cost you popularity.

Save. Autosave runs every few seconds. Use Menu → Saved games for 3 manual slots.

Story text is in English; menus can be switched to French in the menu.

The rules were never only for Sam.
